paragraphs.text: Local ComfyUI workbench for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): image/audio/video generation, W2/W3 sprite cards
with Qwen back-view walk-up and scale lock, local Flux.2 Klein Item Studio assets with guided SDXL
fallback, Hugging Face downloads, inspection and arbitrary workflows. 164 tests.
# dsh-comfyui-workbench
A local **ComfyUI workbench for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**.
It combines media generation, sprite animation, item-studio assets, Hugging Face model downloads, an
d advanced tools that expose the rest of ComfyUI:
| Tool | What it does |

| `generate_image` | Text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting and background removal |
| `generate_

audio` | Music/audio generation with ACE-Step 1.5 |
| `generate_video` | Short video generation with

Wan 2.1 text-to-video |
| `generate_sprite_animation` | One-call W2/W3 turn → video → sprite card p

ipeline from a base PNG |
| `item_studio` | Catalogue-driven item generation, BiRefNet cutout, 64/ta

ll sprites and 32 px icons |
| `comfyui_inspect` | Browse every installed model, node, schema, queue

entry and history item |
| `comfyui_workflow` | Validate and run arbitrary API-format workflows, up

load inputs and control jobs |
| `comfyui_api` | Reach any other ComfyUI HTTP endpoint |
| `huggingf
ace_models` | Search Hugging Face, list model files and download models for ComfyUI |
Everything runs against a ComfyUI server you control. There is no commercial API and no cloud accoun
t. The only runtime package is DSH's small `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` schema validator; everything e
lse uses Node's built-in `fetch`, `FormData` and filesystem APIs.
> Published on npm as **`dsh-comfyui-workbench`**. Current release: **0.8.0**.
## Why This Exists
DSH has no media generation of its own, while an Agent frequently needs to draw a picture, edit an i
mage, generate a track, make a short clip, discover what a local ComfyUI can run, or execute a workf
low no high-level tool covers.
This plugin gives the Agent all of those paths in one bundle:

- **Simple paths** with sensible defaults: `generate_image`, `generate_audio`, `generate_video`.
- *
*Escape hatches** for the full ComfyUI surface: `comfyui_inspect`, `comfyui_workflow`, `comfyui_api`

, plus `huggingface_models` for getting models in the first place.
- **Actionable failures**: when a
required model or node is missing, the error says what was detected and what is missing instead of

returning an opaque ComfyUI node failure.
- **Local-first operation**: generation requests go to the
configured ComfyUI `baseUrl`; generated files land in the current project root by default. Hugging
Face is contacted only when you explicitly use `huggingface_models`.
## Capabilities
## Requirements
| Item | Requirement |

| DSH | A version with the `tools` service; the plugin declares `dsh.engines.dsh >= 0.2.0-rc.1` |
|

Node.js | **>= 20** (built-in `fetch` / `FormData` / `Blob`) |
| ComfyUI | A reachable ComfyUI servi

ce, default `http://127.0.0.1:8188` |
| Image generation | At least one checkpoint in `models/checkp

oints` |
| Audio generation | ACE-Step 1.5 AIO checkpoint or the split model layout |
| Video genera

tion | Wan 2.1 T2V diffusion model, UMT5 safetensors encoder and Wan VAE |
| Model downloads | Optio

nal Hugging Face token; a local `ComfyUI/models` path for direct installs |
| Sprite animation | Wan
2.2 i2v Q4 GGUFs, UMT5, Wan 2.1 VAE, GGUF/VRAM helper nodes and ComfyUI-RMBG (`BiRefNet_lite`); wal

k_up prefers Qwen-Image-Edit |
| Item Studio Flux.2 | `flux-2-klein-9b-fp8`, `qwen_3_8b_fp8mixed`, `

full_encoder_small_decoder` |
| Item Studio guided | SDXL, pixel LoRA, ControlNet Union, IPAdapter P

lus, ComfyUI-RMBG |
| Background removal | One supported background-removal node pack (optional) |
Image generation is the baseline. Audio and video are optional and are enabled only when their model
sets are present. If they are missing, the tools return a precise support report; they do not silen
tly substitute a different model family.
> Background removal is the only image mode that needs extra nodes. Supported packs: `ComfyUI_essent
ials`, `ComfyUI-BRIA_AI-RMBG`, `ComfyUI-LayerStyle` and `WAS Node Suite`. The `rembg` Python depende

ncy must have an ONNX runtime, for example `pip install "rembg[cpu]"`.
>
> Core ComfyUI's newer `Rem
oveBackground` node is not wired into this path because it outputs a mask rather than the finished i
mage; use one of the supported packs above.
#### Current video limitation
Only the tested **Wan 2.1 text-to-video** graph is enabled in `generate_video`.
Wan 2.2 I2V/VACE, HunyuanVideo, LTX-Video, SVD, Mochi and other families are intentionally not wired
into the high-level tool because their graphs differ significantly (dual experts, image conditionin
g, VACE control, etc.). Use `comfyui_workflow` with a matching API workflow for those. The detection
error still reports the video files it found so you can see what is available.
See docs/MEDIA.md for complete setup and troubleshooting.
## Security and Limits
- The plugin contacts **only** the configured ComfyUI `baseUrl`. It does not call a cloud service or

telemetry endpoint.
- Local input files are uploaded only to the local ComfyUI `/upload/image` endp

oint.
- `comfyui_workflow` can execute anything the installed nodes can execute. Treat it as **privi

leged local code execution**.
- `comfyui_api` can change ComfyUI state (`/free`, `/queue`, `/setting

s`, custom-node manager routes). Use it deliberately.
- Wait timeouts are capped at one hour; output

downloads at 100 files; raw API text/JSON responses default to 100 KB.
- Local workflow validation

is best-effort; ComfyUI remains the final authority.
- The plugin does not install models or custom
nodes for you, except for files explicitly downloaded with `huggingface_models`. Model licenses and

Hugging Face access are your responsibility.
- The Hugging Face token is used only in Authorization
headers to the configured endpoint; it is never returned in tool output or debug logs. Prefer `HF_TO
KEN` over storing it in config when possible.
